title: Endometriosis quality-of-life check-in (EHP-5)
description: A 5-question version of the gold-standard Endometriosis Health Profile (EHP-30), covering pain, control, emotional well-being, social support, and self-image. Used at baseline and at every 3-month follow-up for patients with suspected or confirmed endometriosis.

items.text: Have you experienced pain during your period (or, if you don't have periods, pelvic pain that comes and goes)?
Have you felt unable to do things that you would have liked to do because of endometriosis or pelvic pain?
Have you felt frustrated or low because of your symptoms?
Have you felt that other people didn't understand what you were going through?
Have you felt unhappy with your appearance (because of bloating, weight, or feeling unwell)?

scoring.note: Standard EHP-5 scoring: sum of items × 25 / 4 = score 0–100 per item; total = mean of the 5 transformed values. Lower = better QoL.

interpretation_bands.label: minimal_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Endometriosis is having a minimal impact on your life right now.

interpretation_bands.label: moderate_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Endometriosis is having a moderate impact on your life.

interpretation_bands.label: substantial_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Endometriosis is substantially affecting your day-to-day life.

interpretation_bands.label: severe_impact
interpretation_bands.patient_label: Endometriosis is severely affecting your quality of life.

thresholds.message: EHP-5 score in the substantial-impact range (≥50). Consider escalating treatment plan or scheduling visit.
EHP-5 score has worsened by ≥25 points compared to baseline. Recommend earlier follow-up visit.

citation: Jones G, Jenkinson C, Kennedy S. Evaluating the responsiveness of the Endometriosis Health Profile Questionnaire: the EHP-30. Qual Life Res 2004;13:705-13. PMID: 15130030
